body:
## Pull request overview

This PR upgrades all @objectstack packages from version 0.6.1 to 0.7.1 across the ObjectUI monorepo. The protocol update is backward compatible, requiring only dependency version updates without any code modifications.

**Changes:**
- Updated @objectstack package versions from 0.6.1 to 0.7.1 across 9 package.json files
- Updated @objectstack/client in packages/data-objectstack from 0.4.1 to 0.7.1
- No code changes required as the protocol remains backward compatible

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 9 out of 9 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| package.json | Updated 5 @objectstack dev dependencies to 0.7.1 (core, driver-memory, objectql, plugin-msw, runtime) |
| packages/types/package.json | Updated @objectstack/spec dependency to 0.7.1 |
| packages/core/package.json | Updated @objectstack/spec dependency to 0.7.1 |
| packages/react/package.json | Updated @objectstack/spec dependency to 0.7.1 |
| packages/data-objectstack/package.json | Updated @objectstack/client from 0.4.1 to 0.7.1 (major version jump) |
| examples/todo/package.json | Updated @objectstack/spec, @objectstack/client, and @objectstack/cli to 0.7.1 |
| examples/msw-todo/package.json | Updated 6 @objectstack dependencies to 0.7.1 |
| examples/crm/package.json | Updated @objectstack/spec and @objectstack/cli to 0.7.1 |
| examples/crm-app/package.json | Updated 6 @objectstack dependencies to 0.7.1 |
</details>
